name: Blackfathom Villainy
summary: Inside Blackfathom Deeps, Blackfathom Villainy reaches a wounded scout who cannot finish his mission alone. Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid asks passing Horde champions to end Twilight Lord Kelris's blood sacrifices to Aku'mai in the sunken ruins.

sections.title: A Desperate Last Stand
sections.body: Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid lies wounded in the underground temple along the Ashenvale coast. His reconnaissance uncovered horrors beyond naga incursions, but his strength is spent and he cannot complete the mission alone. He calls on passing Horde champions to strike at the cult's leaders in the sunken halls.

sections.title: Sacrifices to the Deep
sections.body: Twilight Lord Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer cultists within the ruined Temple of the Moon. With the local naga, he performs dark rites over the defiled Moon Well. Captives are fed alive to Aku'mai, a ravenous hydra and beast of the Old Gods, as Kelris seeks cosmic power and primordial chaos.

sections.title: Word to Thunder Bluff
sections.body: Argent Dawn believed Kelris dead or lost, so word of his fate matters. Thaelrid directs proof of the cult leader's death to Bashana Runetotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Attuned to the Earthmother's natural balance, Bashana honors the victory over a corruption bent on dragging Kalimdor into primeval ruin.

faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris leads the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Blackfathom Deeps. Argent Dawn believed him dead or missing, but he has gathered power by sacrificing captives to the ancient hydra Aku'mai in the corrupted Moon Well.

faq.q: Why is an Argent Dawn member inside Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Argent Dawn scout Thaelrid entered the ruined night elf temple to investigate its growing threat. The dangers there left him mortally weakened and trapped, so he relies on visiting adventurers to finish his duty and kill Kelris.

Aku'mai is an ancient, monstrous hydra with many heads, regarded as a primordial servant of the Old Gods. It woke when corruption from deep underground tainted the temple's sacred waters, and now devours captives brought by the Twilight's Hammer.

faq.q: Why turn the quest in to Bashana Runetotem?
aliases: where to turn in blackfathom villainy
faq.answer: Thaelrid sends Horde champions to Bashana Runetotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. As a steward of the Earthmother's balance, Bashana keeps in touch with defenders against ancient evil and sees Kelris's Old God worship as a blight upon Kalimdor.

faq.q: What happened to the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps was once a subterranean temple sacred to the moon goddess Elune. Upheaval and ancient darkness seeping from the earth tainted the great Moon Well, and naga and doomsday cultists claimed the sunken sanctuaries for their dark master Aku'mai.

faq.q: What is the goal of the Twilight's Hammer cult here?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer seeks to return the world to primordial chaos through worship of the Old Gods. Kelris seeks power through dark communion, feeding innocents to the depths to win the favor of ancient beings.

angles.text: For the Horde, joining forces with an Argent Dawn scout is an uncommon act of shared purpose against a cosmic blight, and earns the Dawn's early favor.
Bashana Runetotem sees Kelris's defeat as a defense of the Earthmother, cleansing an abomination that sought to drive the world's natural order into primeval chaos.
For a druid, the naga and void-worshipping cultists' defilement of an ancient night elf Moon Well wounds Kalimdor's natural and spiritual sanctuary.
For a shaman, Kelris and Aku'mai disturb elemental balance, turning pure underground waters into a place of shadow and sacrifice.
